name: Columbia University
feeMethod: Charges one undergraduate tuition for every major in Columbia College and Columbia Engineering, so every major costs the same.
description: Columbia University is a private Ivy League research university in Manhattan, New York City, founded in 1754 as King's College. It comprises Columbia College, Columbia Engineering and graduate and professional schools including law, business, medicine and international affairs.
whyIncluded: Columbia has a Singapore Students Association for Singaporean students on campus, and the Columbia University Club of Singapore has served local alumni since 1995. Its medical and law degrees are both recognised for practice in Singapore (Singapore Medical Council and Singapore Institute of Legal Education lists).

livingCosts.summary: Columbia's own 9-month estimate for graduate students of housing, food, transport, books and personal costs. Tuition, fees and health insurance are extra.
livingCosts.notes: Columbia GSAS Cost of Attendance 2026-27, 9-month estimate: housing US$17,100; food US$8,388; transportation US$1,359; personal = personal expenses US$3,636 + books and supplies US$1,290 = US$4,926. Undergraduate on-campus budget (cc-seas Facts page) is lower: housing US$13,904, food US$7,586, books US$1,320, personal US$1,844, travel varies.

programmes.name: BS in Mechanical Engineering (Columbia Engineering)
programmes.feeBasis: Columbia's 2026-27 undergraduate tuition (one rate for Columbia College and Columbia Engineering), plus continuing-year fees and the international services charge; the extra first-year fees are counted once.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for Columbia College and Columbia Engineering undergraduates plus university fees and the international services charge. Health insurance not included; fees rise each year.
programmes.notes: Columbia College and Columbia Engineering Financial Aid 'Facts' cost of attendance, 2026-2027: tuition US$72,800; fees US$4,160 (first year on campus) or US$3,430 (continuing). Compulsory = continuing-year fees US$3,430 + International Services Charge US$175/semester x 2 = US$3,780; one-off = first-year fee difference US$730 (new-student fees). Columbia Health Insurance (US$2,218 fall / US$3,605 spring) excluded as waivable with qualifying coverage. Course fees extra. Columbia does not fix fees for a cohort. History (read 2026-10-13) from Columbia OPIR's Common Data Sets for Columbia College and Columbia Engineering, section G1 (the 2025-26 CDS gives exactly the 2026-27 figures above, so same basis): 2024-25 costs (2023-24 CDS) tuition US$68,000, required fees US$3,845 first-year / US$3,170 continuing (one-off difference US$675); 2025-26 costs (2024-25 CDS, marked preliminary) tuition US$70,170, fees US$4,010 / US$3,280 (difference US$730), plus the 2025-26 International Service Charge US$170 per semester from the GSAS 2025-26 cost page = US$3,620. The 2024-25 International Service Charge was not found, so the 2024 row's compulsory fees exclude it. 2024 compulsory fees now include the 2024-25 International Service Charge of US$160 per semester (US$320), from GSAS's own 2024-2025 cost of attendance page, to match the current basis (added 2026-10-13).

programmes.name: MS in Mechanical Engineering (Columbia Engineering)
programmes.feeBasis: Columbia Engineering's 2026-27 rate of US$2,822 per point times 24 points (two full-time semesters), plus yearly graduate fees.
programmes.summary: Tuition for a full-time year of 24 points (US$2,822 a point) plus university and engineering fees. Charged per point, so the final term costs extra. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: Student Financial Services 'Graduate Engineering Cost of Attendance' 2026-2027: US$2,822 per point, 12 points per semester; full-time MS tuition US$67,728 for fall + spring (24 points). Compulsory = International Student Fee US$350 + Health Service Fee US$1,518 + University Services and Support Fee US$1,290 + SEAS Graduate Student Activities Fee US$960 = US$4,118 a year; one-off Document Fee US$105 (first semester). Health insurance (Columbia Student Health Insurance Plan, US$5,823 a year in 2026-27) is excluded: Columbia Health says non-J visa international students may waive it with a plan meeting university requirements. The MS needs 30 points, so a third term is charged per point (typical length 1.5 years). Retried 2026-10-13: the school cost page, SFS cost pages and the Columbia CDS show no earlier-year figure for this programme, archived bulletins are blocked to automated reading and the SFS tuition tool is script-only, so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. 2024 row (2026-10-13): Columbia IEOR's own 'Tuition and Fees' page, headed '2024-2025 Tuition & Fees', gives the Columbia Engineering MS tuition of US$2,584 per credit, so 24 points = US$62,016 (same basis as the current figure; the Engineering catalogue charges one per-credit rate for all MS programmes unless a special fee is fixed); the page lists no fee amounts, so the row is tuition only. 2025 not filled: no 2025-26 per-credit rate was found on Columbia pages, and agent sites (Yocket, Mastersportal) and ISSO's rate sheet give undated figures. 2025 row (2026-10-13, rung 1): Columbia Student Financial Services' 'DoD Tuition Rates Per Credit_2025-26' PDF ('Tuition rates as of August 25, 2025') lists Mechanical Engineering (14.1901) and Computer Science (11.0701) at a graduate rate of US$2,700 per credit, so 24 points = US$64,800 (same per-point basis as the current figure). The 2024 version of the same SFS sheet gives US$2,584, matching the IEOR 2024-25 rate already recorded. Tuition only, as in the 2024 row.

programmes.name: Full-Time MBA (Columbia Business School)
programmes.feeBasis: Columbia Business School's published 2026-27 Full-Time MBA tuition (US$93,908), plus the MBA programme, health and services fees and the international charge.
programmes.summary: First-year MBA tuition plus mandatory university and programme fees and the international services charge. The school expects tuition to rise 2-7% for year two. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: Columbia Business School 'Full-Time MBA and MBAxMS' cost of attendance 2026-2027 (August entry): tuition US$93,908; mandatory fees US$6,783 first year / US$6,678 continuing. Fee breakdown from CBS 'University Fees' page (business.columbia.edu/financial-aid/policies/university-fees): Health Service Fee US$759/term, University Services and Support Fee US$645/term, MBA Program Fee US$1,935/term = US$6,678/yr; plus International Service Charge US$175/term = US$7,028; Document Fee US$105 one-off. The CBS page says international students cannot waive Columbia medical insurance (US$5,823), but Columbia Health allows non-J international students a waiver with a qualifying plan, so insurance is excluded here as elsewhere. Retried 2026-10-13: the school cost page, SFS cost pages and the Columbia CDS show no earlier-year figure for this programme, archived bulletins are blocked to automated reading and the SFS tuition tool is script-only, so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. 2024 and 2025 rows (2026-10-13, unofficial): Poets&Quants (27 Aug 2025, 'Highest Tuition at a U.S. B-School') states Columbia Business School tuition US$91,172 for 2025 and US$88,300 for 2024 (its 2024 article explains the calendar-year labels as the academic year starting that autumn); tuition only, so the rows carry no fees.

The 2025 compulsory figure adds the 2025-26 International Service Charge (US$170 x 2, GSAS 2025-26 cost page) to match the current basis; the 2024-25 charge was not found, so the 2024 row's fees exclude it. 2024 compulsory fees now include the 2024-25 International Service Charge of US$160 per semester (US$320), from GSAS's own 2024-2025 cost of attendance page, to match the current basis (added 2026-10-13). Source: https://www.sile.edu.sg/for-overseas-graduates/qualified-person/#unitedstatesofamerica (read 2026-10-15).

programmes.name: MD (Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons)
programmes.feeBasis: Columbia Vagelos's published 2026-27 MD tuition (US$76,336 each year), plus first-year fees from the school's student budget.
programmes.summary: First-year MD tuition plus compulsory school fees and the international services charge. Health insurance not included. Fees rise each year.
programmes.notes: VP&S MD Program Student Budget 2026-27 ('VP&S - Standard' PDF linked from the budget page; file 41692): tuition US$76,336 each year. First-year compulsory = Student Health Service US$1,788 + Supplemental Insurance US$10 + Disability Insurance US$78 + CUIMC Network Fee US$480 + P&S IT Fee US$148 + Program Fee US$100 + Student Activity Fee US$145 = US$2,749, plus International Services Charge US$350 = US$3,099. Document Fee US$105 one-off. Later years: Program Fee US$500 in MS2, no activity fee after MS1. Medical Insurance Premium US$5,823 excluded (waivable). The Vagelos Scholarship Program meets need with grants; eligibility of international students not confirmed. Columbia's MD (Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons) is on the Second Schedule of Singapore's Medical Registration Act. Retried 2026-10-13: the school cost page, SFS cost pages and the Columbia CDS show no earlier-year figure for this programme, archived bulletins are blocked to automated reading and the SFS tuition tool is script-only, so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 3): CollegeTuitionCompare gives only the 2026-27 tuition and fees (US$79,690), and no dated 2024-25 or 2025-26 VP&S budget was found. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 4): Columbia OPIR's tuition-rates abstract stops at 2023-24, and Student Doctor Network's US$74,840 is not tied to a year (its 'AAMC FACTS 2025-2026' line refers to admissions data), so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. Round 5 (2026-10-13): Columbia SFS's 'Tuition & Fees Tool' (tuition.sfs.columbia.edu; script-driven, read with a headless browser) still offers Fall/Spring 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 terms, and for 2026-27 it reproduces the current figures exactly (checked). Vagelos 'MD, All Students' tuition per term: 2025-26 $37,420, 2024-25 $36,506 (2026-27 $38,168), so annual = x 2 = $74,840 and $73,012. Compulsory on the current first-year basis (health fee x 2 + supplemental insurance + disability insurance + CUIMC technology fee x 2 + IT fee + program fee + activity fee + international services charge x 2): 2025-26 1,720 + 10 + 78 + 464 + 148 + 85 + 145 + 340 = $2,990; 2024-25 1,656 + 10 + 78 + 450 + 148 + 85 + 145 + 320 = $2,892; Document Fee $105 one-off. 2024 and 2025 rows added.

programmes.name: Master's Direct Entry (MDE) Program for Non-Nurses (Columbia Nursing)
programmes.feeBasis: Columbia Nursing's 2026-27 MDE tuition for the first three terms (summer, fall, spring), plus university fees.
programmes.summary: Tuition for the first three terms (summer, fall, spring) of the 15-month nursing master's for non-nurses, plus university fees. A final summer term is extra. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: Columbia Nursing Tuition and Fees 2026-27, Master's Direct Entry full-time traditional track: tuition US$106,222 for the first three terms (Summer, Fall, Spring); University Fees US$3,387 (listed components: Simulation US$25, Technology US$50, CUIMC Network US$240 and Student Activity US$35 per term, Transcript Fee US$105 one-time; the remainder is presumably the health service fee). Compulsory = US$3,387 - US$105 = US$3,282 + International Services Charge US$175 x 2 (fall, spring) = US$3,632; one-off US$105. Health insurance (Summer US$1,356, Fall US$2,218, Spring US$3,605) excluded as waivable. Programme is 15 months (four terms); the fourth term's tuition is not included in this annual figure. Columbia Nursing has a page for MDE international applicants. Retried 2026-10-13: the school cost page, SFS cost pages and the Columbia CDS show no earlier-year figure for this programme, archived bulletins are blocked to automated reading and the SFS tuition tool is script-only, so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 3): Mastersportal's MDE fee (US$82,244 a year) is undated, so it was not used. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 4): SFS's DoD per-credit sheets give nursing at US$1,860 (Aug 2024) and US$1,936 (Aug 2025) per credit, but the current figure is the MDE's three-term programme rate, so they were not used. Round 5 (2026-10-13): Columbia SFS's 'Tuition & Fees Tool' (tuition.sfs.columbia.edu; script-driven, read with a headless browser) still offers Fall/Spring 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 terms, and for 2026-27 it reproduces the current figures exactly (checked).
